title: Whale Peek-a-Boo: Maple's face, the orcas, the sea lion
kaylee: Maple keeps her sweet face when the whale soaks her, the orcas swim round the sea lions' rock instead of into it, and the sea lion looks like a real one.

pictures.title: The orcas
pictures.caption: They swim round the rock now; near it, they slide along its edge

pictures.title: The sea lion
pictures.caption: Sits up on her front flippers: pale muzzle, whiskers, ear flaps, shiny eyes; she looks around and flaps when she barks

pictures.title: Soaked Maple
pictures.caption: No crossed or dizzy eyes: her own face, with wet fur spikes (and seaweed on the biggest splash)
